title: UI catalog
description: Components a shadcn registry index lists, in the index's order, each with the URL of its registry item.

source.description: The site URL, index URL, or index file the caller passed.

index.description: The index URL that was read, or the file path for parse.

name.description: Registry item name, unique within the index.

type.description: shadcn item type, such as registry:ui or registry:block.

itemUrl.description: Registry item URL that ui-source accepts.

cacheHit.description: Always false. An index is read fresh on every call.
